subScenes.name: 偶遇寒暄
subScenes.description: 新搬来的居民在楼道遇见邻居，主动打招呼开启对话。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey, you're new around here, right?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻里偶遇寒暄：对方认出你是新邻居并主动搭话

followUps.text: Yes, just moved in last week! I'm Alex.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，上周刚搬来！我是亚历克斯。

followUps.text: Yeah, I am. Sorry, I'm in a rush right now!
followUps.text_cn: 对，是我。不好意思，我现在赶时间！

followUps.text: Actually, I've lived here for a few months — I just haven't seen you before!
followUps.text_cn: 其实我住这儿几个月了，只是之前没碰见过你！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于邻居主动识别你为新住户时的自然回应，体现社交弹性

qaPairs.triggerText: How's the new place treating you?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻里偶遇寒暄：对方关心你对新居的适应情况

followUps.text: Pretty good! The neighbors are super friendly, and the park nearby is a bonus.
followUps.text_cn: 还不错！邻居都很友善，附近还有个公园，真是加分项。

followUps.text: It's okay, but the noise from upstairs is driving me crazy.
followUps.text_cn: 还行吧，就是楼上的噪音快把我逼疯了。

followUps.text: Still unpacking — but I’m getting there!
followUps.text_cn: 还在 unpacking，但慢慢来着！

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应关于居住体验的问题，可展现积极、真实或略带幽默的态度

qaPairs.triggerText: You're out walking your dog? I haven't seen him before.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你出来遛狗啊？我之前没见过它。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻里偶遇寒暄：对方注意到你的宠物并以此开启话题

followUps.text: Yeah, this is Max! He's a golden retriever — super social, loves meeting people.
followUps.text_cn: 对，这是Max！金毛犬，特别爱社交，喜欢认识新朋友。

followUps.text: Uh, actually, he's not mine — I'm just dog-sitting for my neighbor.
followUps.text_cn: 呃，其实他不是我的，我只是帮邻居照看几天。

followUps.text: I don't have a dog — I'm just out for a quick walk.
followUps.text_cn: 我没养狗，只是出来散个步。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当邻居误认宠物归属时，提供三种应对策略：接纳、澄清、纠正，增强真实对话适应力

subScenes.name: 自我介绍
subScenes.description: 双方互相介绍姓名和搬来时间，建立初步联系。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hi, I'm new here — I just moved in next door. What's your name?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嗨，我是新搬来的，就住在隔壁。你叫什么名字？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居主动自我介绍并询问姓名，学习者回应

followUps.text: Nice to meet you! I'm Alex. I've lived here for three years.
followUps.text_cn: 很高兴认识你！我是亚历克斯，住这儿三年了。

followUps.text: Hi, I'm Jamie. Nice to meet you too — hope we can be good neighbors!
followUps.text_cn: 嗨，我是杰米，也很高兴认识你，希望我们能成为好邻居！

followUps.text: Oh, hi. I'm Taylor. Just settling in — nice to meet you.
followUps.text_cn: 哦，嗨，我是泰勒，刚搬来安顿，很高兴认识你。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于初次见面的邻里寒暄，回应时可根据性格选择热情、礼貌或保守风格

qaPairs.triggerText: You're the new person in 3B, right? How long have you been here?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你是3B的新住户吧？你搬来多久了？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居确认身份并询问入住时间，学习者回应

followUps.text: Yeah! I moved in last Friday — still unpacking, haha.
followUps.text_cn: 对！我上周五搬进来的，还在拆箱子呢，哈哈。

followUps.text: Actually, I moved in two weeks ago — I was away on business first.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我两周前就搬来了，之前因为出差耽搁了。

followUps.text: Uh, yeah — I'm in 3B. Just got here yesterday.
followUps.text_cn: 呃，对，我住3B，昨天刚到。

qaPairs.usageNote: 邻居可能通过楼号确认身份，回应时可结合真实经历调整细节，增强自然感

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any pets? I've got a dog and sometimes he barks late at night.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你养宠物吗？我养了条狗，有时半夜会叫。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居提及宠物问题，试探性沟通，学习者回应

followUps.text: I do! I have a cat — sorry if she’s noisy sometimes!
followUps.text_cn: 我有！我养了只猫，如果她吵到你了我先道歉！

followUps.text: No pets for me — but I totally get it. Dogs are part of the family!
followUps.text_cn: 我没养宠物，但我完全理解，狗就是家人！

followUps.text: I used to have a dog, but he passed away last year. I’m not ready for another yet.
followUps.text_cn: 我以前有条狗，去年去世了，现在还没准备好养新的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 宠物话题常是邻里破冰关键，回应需兼顾诚实与社交敏感性，避免生硬拒绝

subScenes.name: 询问设施
subScenes.description: 询问附近超市、垃圾投放点等生活便利信息。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you know if there's a laundry room in the building?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你知道楼里有洗衣房吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻里询问小区公共设施

followUps.text: Yes, it's on the basement floor, next to the gym.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，在地下室，健身房旁边。

followUps.text: I'm not sure—I just moved in last month.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，我上个月才搬来。

followUps.text: You might want to check with the front desk—they handle all building amenities.
followUps.text_cn: 你最好问问前台，他们管所有公共设施。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于邻里间自然询问公共设施，回应需体现友好与真实生活状态

qaPairs.triggerText: Is there a bike storage area around here?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这附近有自行车存放处吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻里询问自行车存放设施

followUps.text: Yeah, there's one right by the east entrance—just look for the locked gate.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，在东门旁边，找那个上锁的门就行。

followUps.text: I've never seen one—I usually take my bike inside my apartment.
followUps.text_cn: 我从没见过，我一般把车带进公寓里。

followUps.text: I think there used to be one, but I heard they removed it last month.
followUps.text_cn: 我记得以前有，但听说上个月拆了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应需反映真实社区变化与个人经验，避免机械回答

qaPairs.triggerText: Are pets allowed in the common areas?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 宠物可以进公共区域吗？

followUps.text: Yes, as long as they're on a leash and you clean up after them.
followUps.text_cn: 可以，只要拴着牵引绳并清理粪便就行。

followUps.text: No, the rules say no pets in the lobby or garden—sorry!
followUps.text_cn: 不行，规定说大堂和花园不能带宠物，抱歉！

followUps.text: It depends—some people bring theirs in quietly, but officially it's not allowed.
followUps.text_cn: 看情况吧，有些人偷偷带进来，但官方是不允许的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 宠物政策常涉及隐性规则，回应应体现社区文化与现实弹性

subScenes.name: 表达欢迎
subScenes.description: 邻居热情欢迎新住户，并提供生活小贴士。

qaPairs.triggerText: Welcome to the neighborhood! I'm Sam, I live next door.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 欢迎搬来！我是萨姆，就住在隔壁。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 新邻居搬来，老邻居主动表达欢迎

followUps.text: Thanks, Sam! I'm Lisa. I'm so excited to be here!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你，萨姆！我是丽莎，我太兴奋了！

followUps.text: Hi Sam, nice to meet you. I'm still settling in, but I appreciate it!
followUps.text_cn: 嗨，萨姆，很高兴认识你。我还在安顿，但很感谢！

followUps.text: Oh wow, thanks! I’m Alex. Do you know where the nearest grocery store is?
followUps.text_cn: 哦天哪，谢谢！我是亚历克斯。你知道最近的杂货店在哪吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于新邻居初到时，回应对方的热情欢迎，可根据性格和状态选择不同语气的回应

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey, I saw you moving in—welcome! Let me know if you need help with anything.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嘿，我看到你搬进来了——欢迎！需要帮忙随时说。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居主动提供帮助以表达欢迎

followUps.text: That’s so kind of you! I might take you up on that—could you point me to the trash day schedule?
followUps.text_cn: 你太好了！我可能真要麻烦你——能告诉我垃圾日安排吗？

followUps.text: Thanks, I really appreciate it. I’m good for now, but I’ll definitely reach out if I get stuck!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，我很感激。我现在还好，但卡住时一定会找你！

followUps.text: Wow, you’re awesome! I’m actually looking for someone to carpool with—any advice?
followUps.text_cn: 哇，你太棒了！我正想找人拼车——有什么建议吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当邻居主动提出帮助时，回应可体现开放、谨慎或顺势建立联系三种态度

qaPairs.triggerText: I made some cookies—thought you might like some! Welcome aboard!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我烤了些饼干，想着你可能会喜欢！欢迎加入！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居用小礼物表达欢迎

followUps.text: Oh my gosh, these are amazing! Thank you so much—I’ll bring you something tomorrow!
followUps.text_cn: 天啊，太好吃了！太谢谢你了——明天我回赠你点什么！

followUps.text: That’s so thoughtful! I’m actually on a diet, but I’ll save one for later!
followUps.text_cn: 太贴心了！我正在节食，但我会留一个以后吃！

followUps.text: You didn’t have to do that—but I’m really touched. I’m Maya, by the way!
followUps.text_cn: 你本不必这样的——但我真的很感动。对了，我叫玛雅！

qaPairs.usageNote: 面对邻居送小礼物的欢迎方式，回应需体现文化习惯中的礼尚往来与情感回应

subScenes.name: 礼貌告别
subScenes.description: 双方友好道别，约定未来再聊，结束对话。

qaPairs.triggerText: Well, I should head out now.

followUps.text: Oh, okay! Let’s catch up again soon!
followUps.text_cn: 哦，好的！咱们改天再聊！

followUps.text: Sure, thanks for the chat — have a great evening!
followUps.text_cn: 当然，谢谢聊天，祝你晚上愉快！

followUps.text: Wait, before you go — can you water my plants this week?
followUps.text_cn: 等一下，你走之前能帮我浇一下花吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于邻居主动告别时，你如何自然、得体地回应。避免冷淡或过度拖延，保持友好但不冗长。

qaPairs.triggerText: I’ve got to run — nice seeing you!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我得走了，很高兴见到你！

followUps.text: Same here! Take care!
followUps.text_cn: 我也是！保重！

followUps.text: You too! Oh, by the way, my dog’s barking again — any advice?
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！对了，我家狗又叫了，有建议吗？

followUps.text: Alright, see you tomorrow at the mailbox!
followUps.text_cn: 好，明天邮箱那儿见！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方用轻松语气告别时，回应应保持轻快，可顺势建立日常联系点，如共用信箱、遛狗等。

qaPairs.triggerText: I’m heading home — it’s been lovely chatting.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我回家了，和你聊天真开心。

followUps.text: It really has! Let’s make coffee next week?
followUps.text_cn: 真的很有意思！下周一起喝咖啡？

followUps.text: Absolutely — have a safe trip home!
followUps.text_cn: 当然！路上小心！

followUps.text: Oh, wait — do you know if the trash pickup is moved this week?
followUps.text_cn: 等等，你知道这周垃圾收集时间改了吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方表达情感温度时，回应可选择加深联系、单纯礼貌回应，或利用机会解决实际问题，三者皆自然。
